changelog:
**Major upgrade: Switched to JSON template-driven multi-layer video rendering with flexible compositing and audio features.**

- Replaces shell scripts with a modular Python backend (`render.py` and per-feature scripts)
- Introduces a JSON-based project template supporting z-index compositing, advanced FX (slide, zoom, ken_burns, etc.), and audio (narration, BGM, SFX)
- Deep per-clip subtitle binding with granular style overrides
- Global or auto-selected theming for fonts and visual style
- All video, image, and audio assets referenced and managed via template schema
- Removed legacy shell workflows; now render entire video projects with a single command
summary: Use this skill when rendering a JSON project template into a video.
